projects.title: Venuent
projects.description:
Developed an events website builder startup in 3 weeks with complete functional prototype, business model, go-to market strategy, investment plan, and negotiated contracts with several paying enterprise customers. Presented to Google developers as well as European and Silicon Valley VC's.

*Best Design Award 
*Voted 1 out of the top 15 (out of 70) best applications for technological complexity & functionality
*Voted 1 out of the top 15 best teams, overall
